investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Brightlane Media (news publishing); Platform: AWS eu-central-1 (zones eu-central-1a/1b/1c); VPC range: 10.30.0.0/16 (one /24 per tier per zone); Database tier: self-managed MySQL 8.0 primary/replica pair on EC2 with EBS gp3 volumes behind ProxySQL; Application tier: web-frontend, content-api and comment-svc on EC2 auto-scaling groups; Change management: CHG- identifiers.
